code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, metabolic acidosis (low pH, low O2, low O2 saturation), leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, high creatinine (suggesting renal impairment), markedly elevated ferritin, LDH, D-dimer, and INR. These findings are suggestive of severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or multi-organ dysfunction, and a prothrombotic state. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
